scientific_integrity: The proof is algebraic in characteristic three; finite-field verification is corroborative, not a replacement for the universal claim. Earlier geometric normal forms and elliptic quotients are credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact characteristic-three smooth ordered-parameter normal form only. Counts do not quotient by isomorphism. Published equations predate 2023, and some classical equivalent p-rank computations could be unindexed.
title: The three disjoint nonordinary strata of a genus-three Klein-involution family in characteristic three
